purpose: Teach: 州立/施主/廻っ/下層/席上/呼応/デマンド/無休

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 州立大学の就職フェアに参加しましょう
lines.en: Let's participate in the state university job fair.
lines.style: Energetic, forward-moving. Sharp attack on the opening. Professional confidence — this is a directive she's thought through. Crisp pace, no hedging. The tone of someone who's already mentally moved to the next step.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。建築の施主向け資料を準備します
lines.en: Yes. I'll prepare the construction client materials.
lines.style: Warm agreement, immediate ownership. Steady, competent. Slight nod in the voice — not obsequious, just reliably on the same page. No flourish, just follow-through.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 支店を廻って様子を確認しましょう
lines.en: Let's make the rounds through the branches and check on things.
lines.style: Measured directive. Deliberate pace — she's thinking through the logistics as she speaks. Light emphasis on 'check' — this is about gathering real information, not just a formality. Grounded, methodical.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。組織の下層からの提案も募集します
lines.en: Yes. I'll also gather proposals from the lower levels of the organization.
lines.style: Engaged update, slightly buoyed. He's adding value beyond the ask. Calm confidence — this is someone who understands the work and sees how to make it better. Smooth delivery, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 総会の席上で謝辞を述べましょう
lines.en: Let's offer our thanks at the general assembly meeting.
lines.style: Formal but not stiff. Clear priority shift — this is important. Slight weight on 'thanks,' acknowledgment of the moment's dignity. Professional warmth, no rush.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場ニーズに呼応する商品を出します
lines.en: Yes. We'll release products that respond to market needs.
lines.style: Committed affirmation. Steady, assured. The voice of someone who understands both the strategy and the execution. Slight emphasis on 'market needs' — that's the anchor. No doubt, just capability.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: デマンド分析チームを編成しましょう
lines.en: Let's form a demand analysis team.
lines.style: Clear, strategic directive. Slightly lifted — this signals a new phase. Confident pacing, as though the structure is already taking shape in her mind. Purposeful without urgency.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。コールセンターを無休運営します
lines.en: Yes. The call center will operate without any days off.
lines.style: Resolute commitment. Steady, unflinching — he's stating a decision that matters. No apology, no softening. The understated weight of someone who knows what this demands but accepts it. Firm close.
